phase: exploratory stress tests, before skill-guided qualifying A/B runs
thinking_mode: native model reasoning; not forcibly disabled
prose_instruction: Write a complete, original story of about 2500 words about a lighthouse keeper and a cartographer discovering that their maps disagree. Include dialogue, a genuine disagreement resolved through evidence, and a definite ending. Write the story itself, not an outline.
background: Seeded synthetic word document, trimmed using the server tokenizer before timing; model seed and prompt SHA256 recorded per row. Prefix cache flushed before each request.
timing: Wall latency includes prefill and all reasoning/content. TTFT is first nonempty reasoning or content delta. Window rate re-tokenizes accepted text over first30s after that delta, or whole answer if shorter; no speculative proposal counts.
output_sanity: Post-generation scope/repetition grading; failed or looping outputs are retained and excluded from speed-win claims. Eight-word repeated-shingle fraction follows skill helper.
raw_outputs: exploratory-prose.jsonl.gz contains complete recorded synthetic response objects. Summary hashes bind reasoning+content.
comparability: Exploratory profiles were not interleaved with adjacent controls; these rows must not establish a configuration gain.
